title: Prohibition of marking by an unauthorised person
rule: Only a grader may mark timber, and only an inspector may mark or place a mark on other forest produce, with any mark prescribed under the Act. No one may use a mark confusingly similar to a prescribed mark.
points: Pairs with the registered-mark and transit-pass system in the 2004 Regulations (reg 39 to 43) — this is the Act-level source for that marking regime.
Also pairs with s.90 (counterfeiting), which criminalises forging, altering or fraudulently using any mark, stamp, licence, permit or certificate issued under the Act.
checks: Was the mark applied by an authorised grader/inspector
Is the mark identical to or confusingly similar to a prescribed mark
